# apple_territories (Data Source)

Lists the territories where the App Store sells apps, for availability and pricing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_territories" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (Set of String) IDs of the territories, e.g. `USA`, for `for_each`.
- `territories` (Attributes List) The territories, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--territories))

<a id="nestedatt--territories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `territories`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency of the territory, e.g. `USD`.
- `id` (String) ID of the territory: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, e.g. `USA`.
